purpose: Emit identical raw ASCII/UTF16/string-index bytes as GNU .incbin rodata instead of millions of C scalar constants
domain: Linux/GNU assembler, compilation host and target share byte order and char16_t/uint32_t ABI
constraints: One generated module per compilation and a dedicated output directory; binary pool filenames are module-local compiler temporaries
Compiler host and target must share byte order and char16_t/uint32_t ABI
Pool paths are generated local build paths; GNU assembler .incbin files must remain available until host compilation finishes
